references.title: Entropy-guided watermarking for LLMs: A test-time framework for robust and traceable text generation
references.design_use: Motivated entropy-dependent eligibility at test time and predeclared entropy thresholds.
references.task_distinction: The cited method concerns watermarking and cumulative watermark entropy. Revision V3 implements a RankCloak-specific positionwise gate for arbitrary payload-symbol consumption and does not claim task equivalence.
